bandReport.notes: Band covers Q1-Q27 across p00 (Q1-Q10), p01 (Q11-Q20), p02 (Q21-Q27). Layout is two-column throughout: read LEFT column top-to-bottom then RIGHT column, and the numbering follows that order (p00 left 1-5, right 6-10; p01 left 11-15, right 16-20; p02 left 21-23, right 24-27). Q1 is the paper's first question, so nothing precedes it. SEAM: Q27 is complete on p02 — its stem and all four options print there — and p03 opens cleanly at Q28 (left column) and Q31 (right column), so no question straddles the p02/p03 boundary in either direction. NO Directions block and NO 'Consider the following for the next N items' block exists anywhere in p00-p02: every question here is a standalone MCQ with no shared stimulus, so this band opens no set and inherits none. p03 was opened and also carries no Directions block, so nothing is pending across the seam. NO FIGURES in this band: every geometry item (Q11, Q12, Q13, Q14, Q15, Q16, Q17, Q18, Q25) states all its data in words and none says 'in the figure given below' or refers to a diagram; verified by reading each page image in full. Q22 and Q24 both print option (c) as 'Both 1 and II' with an arabic digit 1 — flagged on each, transcribed as printed. questions.stem: A real number M is squared to give the value N. What is the minimum value of \((M + N)\) ?
questions.subtopic: Maximum and Minimum of Quadratic Expressions

questions.stem: What is the sum of all 3-digit numbers that give a remainder of 5 when they are divided by 50 ?
If the average of 64, 69, 72, 75, \(x\) lies between 62 and 76 (excluding 62 and 76), then what is the number of possible integer values of \(x\) ?
Let \(x, y, z\) be variables such that \((x + y + z) = k\), where \(k\) is a constant. If \((x + z - y) \times (x - z + y)\) is proportional to \(yz\), then \((y + z - x)\) is proportional to :
Let \(p\) be the remainder when \(7^{84}\) is divided by 342 and \(q\) be the remainder when \(7^{84}\) is divided by 344. What is \((p - q)\) equal to ?
N is the smallest 5-digit number which when divided by \(2, 2^2, 2^3, 2^4, \ldots, 2^n\) leaves a remainder 1. What is the value of \(n\) ?
What is the minimum value of \(p\) for which \(\dfrac{1}{532900} + \dfrac{p^2}{266450} + \dfrac{p^4}{523900}\) is an integer ?
flags: Third denominator is printed 523900, verified at 8x zoom. The first two are 532900 and 266450 = 532900/2, so 523900 looks like a digit transposition of 532900 in the printed paper. Transcribed exactly as printed; not repaired.

questions.stem: If \(\alpha\) and \(\beta\) are the roots of the equation \(x + a + b = \dfrac{abx}{ab + ax + bx}\), then what is \((\alpha\beta + \alpha + \beta)\) equal to ?
questions.subtopic: Vieta's Relations and Root Coefficient Identities

questions.stem: Consider a 2-digit number N. Let P be the product of the digits of the number. If P is added to square of the digit in the tens place of N, we get 84. If P is added to the square of the digit in the unit place of N, we get 60. What is the value of \(P + N\) ?

A mixture of 100 L contains kerosene and turpentine oil in the ratio 3 : 2. What is the minimum quantity of kerosene in litres (whole number) that should be mixed in the mixture so that the resulting mixture has 20% of kerosene ?

A lamp is kept on a vertical pole. The height of the top of the lamp above the ground is \(\dfrac{5\sqrt{3}}{2}\) m. The perpendicular distances of the bottom of the pole from two adjacent walls meeting perpendicularly are 0.7 m and 2.4 m. What is the distance of the top of the lamp from the corner point of the walls on the ground ?
C is the centre of a circle of radius 20 cm. AB is a chord of length 32 cm. E is a point on AB such that CE = 13 cm. What is \(AE \times EB\) equal to ?
The inside of a bowl is part of a sphere. When water is put into the bowl to a depth \(d\), the water surface becomes a circle of radius \(2d\). What is the radius of the sphere ?
In a triangle ABC, AB = 2 cm, BC = 4 cm and AC = 3 cm. The bisector of angle A meets BC at D and the bisector of angle B meets AD at E. What is AE : ED equal to ?
In a triangle ABC, the bisector of angle A cuts BC at D. If AB + AC = 10 cm and BD : DC = 3 : 1, then what is the length of AC ?
In a triangle ABC, AB + BC = 7.1 cm, BC + CA = 12.1 cm and CA + AB = 7.2 cm. What is the area of the triangle ?
The adjacent sides of a parallelogram are 10 cm and 8 cm and the angle between them is \(150^\circ\). What is the area of the parallelogram ?
The measure of an angle formed by the bisectors of the angles A and C of the triangle ABC is \(130^\circ\). What is the measure of the angle B ?

questions.subtopic: Logarithm Identities and Change of Base

questions.stem: If \(\dfrac{\log_{10}(100001 - 4^x)}{5 - x} = 1\), then what is \(x\) equal to ?
If \(2 \sin^4 \alpha + 2 \cos^4 \alpha - 1 = 0\), where \(0 \le \alpha < \pi/2\), then what is \(\sin 2\alpha + \cos 2\alpha\) equal to ?

Consider the following :

I. \(1 - \sin^6 \alpha = \cos^2 \alpha (\cos^4 \alpha - 3 \cos^2 \alpha + 3)\)

II. \(\cos^8 \alpha - \sin^8 \alpha = 2 \sin^2 \alpha (1 - \cos^4 \alpha + \sin^2 \alpha \cos^2 \alpha)\)

Which of the above is/are identities ?
flags: Option (c) is printed "Both 1 and II" with the ARABIC DIGIT 1 in place of the Roman numeral I — verified at 7x zoom. Transcribed exactly as printed. The same slip appears in Q24 on this page, but Q29 on p03 prints "Both I and II" correctly, so it is a per-question typesetting slip, not a paper-wide house style.

questions.stem: If \(p = \dfrac{1}{\operatorname{cosec} \theta + \cot \theta}\) and \(q = \operatorname{cosec} \theta\), then what is \(p^2 - 2pq\) equal to ?

Consider the following statements :

I. \((\operatorname{cosec} \alpha - \sec \alpha)\) is always positive in the first quadrant.

II. \((\tan \alpha - \cot \alpha)\) is always negative in the first quadrant.

Which of the statements given above is/are correct ?
flags: Option (c) is printed "Both 1 and II" with the ARABIC DIGIT 1 in place of the Roman numeral I — verified at 7x zoom. Transcribed exactly as printed. Same slip as Q22 on this page.

questions.stem: A tower subtends an angle \(60^\circ\) at a point A on the same level as the foot of the tower. B is a point vertically above A and AB = h. The angle of depression of the foot of the tower, measured from B is \(30^\circ\). What is the height of the tower ?
What is \(\dfrac{\sin \theta}{1 - \cot \theta} + \dfrac{\cos \theta}{1 - \tan \theta}\) \((\theta \ne \pi/4)\) equal to ?
The length of an arc of a circle of radius 4 cm is \(\pi\) cm. What is the magnitude of the angle subtended by the arc at the centre ?
